title: Amazon Seller Central Review Scraper input
description: Step 1 (once): Mode = Login → sign in yourself in the Live View tab; the session is saved per region. Step 2: Mode = Scrape → reviews out. Sessions are checked at the start of every run; when one expires, run Login mode again. One row per review: ASIN, Created Date, Has Photo, Reviewer, Review Ratings, Review Title, Review Text, Country, Review Link, Image URL, Review ID, Order ID, Product Rating, Ratings Count.

mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: 🔎 Scrape reviews (uses your saved or pasted sessions)
🔐 Login — sign in once in Live View and save the session
mode.description: First time? Choose Login, pick your marketplaces, start, then open the run's Live View tab and sign in to Seller Central yourself (email, password, 2-step code). The session is saved privately in your Apify account. After that, run in Scrape mode — no copying cookies.

marketplaces.title: Marketplaces
marketplaces.description: Which Seller Central marketplaces to scrape. DE / IT / FR / ES / UK all use the one Europe session and are scraped one after another (DE → IT → FR → ES → UK).

loginTimeoutMinutes.title: Login mode: minutes to sign in (per region)
loginTimeoutMinutes.description: How long Login mode waits for you to finish signing in to each region before moving on.

sessionUS.title: 🇺🇸 US session
sessionUS.description: Optional — not needed if you used Login mode. Fallback: Paste your logged-in Seller Central session for 🇺🇸 US (sellercentral.amazon.com). Easiest: install the free Cookie-Editor browser extension → open https://sellercentral.amazon.com/brand-customer-reviews/ while logged in → Cookie-Editor → Export → JSON → paste here. A raw Cookie: request header copied from DevTools also works. ⚠️ Sessions expire — copy a fresh one before each scheduled run (at least every few days). Stored encrypted; never logged.
sessionUS.sectionDescription: Only if you prefer not to use Login mode. A pasted session takes priority over a saved one for that region.

sessionEU.title: 🇪🇺 Europe session
sessionEU.description: Optional — not needed if you used Login mode. Fallback: Paste your logged-in Seller Central session for 🇪🇺 Europe (sellercentral-europe.amazon.com). Easiest: install the free Cookie-Editor browser extension → open https://sellercentral-europe.amazon.com/brand-customer-reviews/ while logged in → Cookie-Editor → Export → JSON → paste here. A raw Cookie: request header copied from DevTools also works. One Europe session covers DE, IT, FR, ES and UK. ⚠️ Sessions expire — copy a fresh one before each scheduled run (at least every few days). Stored encrypted; never logged.

maxPagesPerMarketplace.title: Max pages per marketplace
maxPagesPerMarketplace.description: Newest reviews first. Reviews per marketplace ≈ pages × page size (30 × 50 = 1,500). Stops early when reviews run out.

minReviewDate.title: Only reviews on/after (yyyy-mm-dd)
minReviewDate.description: Optional. Also stops paging early once pages are older than this date.

asinFilter.title: ASIN filter
asinFilter.description: Optional. Keep only reviews of these ASINs (child ASINs).

fetchOrderId.title: Fetch Order ID
fetchOrderId.description: Adds the Amazon order ID of verified-purchase reviews (from Seller Central's own reviews API, same session).

fetchImages.title: Fetch reviewer photo URLs
fetchImages.description: Fills Has Photo / Image URL. Needs an Amazon shopper session below (photos are only shown to signed-in shoppers).

storefrontSession.title: Amazon shopper (storefront) session — for photos
storefrontSession.description: Only if Fetch photos is on: Cookie-Editor JSON exports from the Amazon store sites (e.g. www.amazon.com, www.amazon.de) while signed in as a shopper. You can paste several exports one after another inside one JSON array.

accountUS.title: Account name (US)
accountUS.sectionDescription: Only needed if Seller Central shows 'Select an account' for your login. Type the account name exactly as shown there.

accountEU.title: Account name (Europe)
accountEU.description: e.g. 'Spigen EU'. Also used to switch between DE / IT / FR / ES / UK.

outputFieldNames.title: Output field names
enumTitles: Title Case (ASIN, Created Date, Has Photo …)

detectionAvoidance.title: Pace
enumTitles: HIGH — slowest, safest for big/frequent runs
detectionAvoidance.description: Delays and scrolling between pages. Every page load also retries with backoff (8s → 25s → 60s) on throttling or robot checks, and regions are scraped one after another.

returnRefreshedSessions.title: Save refreshed sessions
returnRefreshedSessions.description: Amazon rotates session cookies while you browse. When on, the refreshed cookies are saved to this run's key-value store (record REFRESHED_SESSIONS, private to your account) so you can paste them into the next run and keep sessions alive longer.

useSavedSessions.title: Use sessions saved by Login mode
useSavedSessions.description: Scrape mode reuses the sessions you saved with Login mode (when that region's paste field is empty).

saveSessions.title: Keep saved sessions fresh
saveSessions.description: After a successful region, the refreshed cookies (Amazon rotates them while you browse) are saved back, so sessions last longer. Pasted sessions are saved this way too, so next time you don't need to paste.

sessionStoreName.title: Session store name
sessionStoreName.description: Named key-value store in YOUR Apify account that holds saved sessions (one record per region: SESSION_US, SESSION_EU …). Use a different name per brand / seller account. Delete the store to forget all sessions.
